system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform this action twice simultaneously for two different entities: shcportal_search_reports. Here are my details: my aadhaar_number is 100020003789.

function.name: shcportal_search_reports
function.description: Searches for available Soil Health Card reports for a farmer. Returns list of reports with sample IDs, dates, land parcels, and report_status. Requires session_token. Does NOT retrieve full report details — use shcportal_get_report_details. Fails if no reports exist. May return multiple reports across years and land parcels.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
